cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je prohloubit znalosti studentů o chemii sacharidů, surovinách potřebných pro výrobu škrobu a sacharózy včetně technologií, pomocí kterých jsou v současnosti z těchto surovin získávány. Předat informace o hlavních surovinách cukrovinkářského průmyslu a jejich uplatnění při výrobě jednotlivých druhů čokoládových a nečokoládových cukrovinek. Naučit a získat základní dovednosti při analýzách surovin škrobárenského a cukrovarnického průmyslu a výrobků cukrovinkářského průmyslu.

cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Zápočet - povinná účast na cvičení, požadována aktivní účast, odevzdání protokolů z praktických cvičení, odevzdání seminární práce, prezentace a obhajoba seminární práce, povinná účast na exkurzi, zápis z exkurze. Napsání testu s 80% úspěšností. Opravné testy se píší ve 12.týdnu. Zkouška - písemná a ústní, písemná část zkoušky, v délce 30 min, se skládá z 8mi bodově ohodnocených otázek. K ústní zkoušce je nutné získat 65 % z celkového počtu bodů. K ukončení předmětu je požadovaná znalost cvičení, přednášek a doporučené literatury. Celkové ukončení předmětu a získání kreditů zahrnuje aktivní účast na přednáškách a cvičeních, hodnocení testů a seminární práce ze cvičení, hodnocení písemné i ústní části zkoušky.

en.content: none
Chemistry of carbohydrates, classification, nomenclature, physical and chemical properties, oxidation and reduction reactions in acidic and alkaline environments, glucosides. (allowance 2/2)
Major monosaccharides, oligosaccharides, polysaccharides, characteristics, storage polysaccharides, construction polysaccharides, pectins, etc. (allowance 2/2)
Potatoes and their processing. History, importance and use of potato production in the CR, anatomical and chemical composition of potato tubers, potato quality. (allowance 2/2)
Potato products. Requirements for raw materials, modification before the processing, products of wet, frozen, fried, dried, mixed. Processing lines. (allowance 2/2)
Starch Technology. Requirements for raw materials, production of potato starch. Production of starch from wheat and corn. (allowance 2/2)
Starch products. Derivatives of starch, starch hydrolyzate, dextrin, modified starch, glucose syrup, glucose and their use in the food industry and other sectors. (allowance 2/2)
Technology of sugar beet. History, importance, current status, the production of sugar and sugar beet, anatomical structure and chemical composition of sugar beet. (allowance 2/2)
Technological quality of sugar beet. Purchase and receiving of sugar beet, storage, transport and washing sugar beet in sugar factory. (allowance 2/2)
Production of sweet pulp, cutters, lifting diffusion juice, extractors.Limekiln, set of operations to obtain sugar, beet juice purification, clarification, saturation, filtration. (allowance 2/2)
Light juice, juice evaporation, evaporator, heavy juice, cooking confectionery, fundamentals of crystallization, the process of cooking. (allowance 2/2)

Cooling and centrifugation confectionery, the products after the first crystallization of sugar. Production of white goods, the method of purification of raw sugar, clergy, bleaching, refining, production schemes. Production of white table sugar.White table sugar, requirements. Packaging and storage, production control, residues and waste production of sugar beet, molasses, and its use. Production of cane sugar. (allowance 2/2)

Technology of production of chocolate and confectionery. Cocoa beans and their treatment. Production of cocoa mass, chocolate mass and its heat treatment, tempering, molding. Manufacture of cocoa powder.Non-chocolate confectionery. Sugar confectionery with no crystallized sugar, other sweets, dragees, oriental sweets. (allowance 2/2)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim is to deepen students' knowledge of carbohydrate chemistry, raw materials needed for production of starch and sucrose, including technology, through which are currently obtained from these raw materials. Forward information on major materials of candy industry and their use in the manufacture of various types of chocolates and candies. Learn and acquire basic skills in the analysis of raw materials of starch and sugar industry and products of candy industry.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Chemistry of carbohydrates, classification, nomenclature, physical and chemical properties, oxidation and reduction reactions in acidic and alkaline environments, glucosides. (allowance 2/2)2.Major monosaccharides, oligosaccharides, polysaccharides, characteristics, storage polysaccharides, construction polysaccharides, pectins, etc. (allowance 2/2)3.Potatoes and their processing. History, importance and use of potato production in the CR, anatomical and chemical composition of potato tubers, potato quality. (allowance 2/2)4.Potato products. Requirements for raw materials, modification before the processing, products of wet, frozen, fried, dried, mixed. Processing lines. (allowance 2/2)5.Starch Technology. Requirements for raw materials, production of potato starch. Production of starch from wheat and corn. (allowance 2/2)6.Starch products. Derivatives of starch, starch hydrolyzate, dextrin, modified starch, glucose syrup, glucose and their use in the food industry and other sectors. (allowance 2/2)7.Technology of sugar beet. History, importance, current status, the production of sugar and sugar beet, anatomical structure and chemical composition of sugar beet. (allowance 2/2)8.Technological quality of sugar beet. Purchase and receiving of sugar beet, storage, transport and washing sugar beet in sugar factory. (allowance 2/2)9.Production of sweet pulp, cutters, lifting diffusion juice, extractors.Limekiln, set of operations to obtain sugar, beet juice purification, clarification, saturation, filtration. (allowance 2/2)10.Light juice, juice evaporation, evaporator, heavy juice, cooking confectionery, fundamentals of crystallization, the process of cooking. (allowance 2/2)11.Cooling and centrifugation confectionery, the products after the first crystallization of sugar. Production of white goods, the method of purification of raw sugar, clergy, bleaching, refining, production schemes. Production of white table sugar.White table sugar, requirements. Packaging and storage, production control, residues and waste production of sugar beet, molasses, and its use. Production of cane sugar. (allowance 2/2)12.Technology of production of chocolate and confectionery. Cocoa beans and their treatment. Production of cocoa mass, chocolate mass and its heat treatment, tempering, molding. Manufacture of cocoa powder.Non-chocolate confectionery. Sugar confectionery with no crystallized sugar, other sweets, dragees, oriental sweets. (allowance 2/2)

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Credit - compulsory attendance at practice, required active participation, submission of protocols on practical practice, submission of seminar work, seminar work presentations and its advocacy, compulsory participation in excursion and note the excursion. Writing a credit test with 80% success rate. Repaired tests are written in 12th week. Exam - written and oral, written exam part of 30 minutes, consists of 8 evaluated questions. The oral exam is necessary to obtain 65 % of the total number of points. The completion of the course is required knowledge of practice, lectures and recommended literature. Total completion of the course and obtaining credits includes active participation in lectures and exercises, evaluation of the seminar work and tests from practice, assessment of written and oral exams.
